caption: The drawing depicts a small object shaped like a building, specifically a bank, as indicated by the word "BANK" written above the entrance. The object is rendered in shades of brown and yellow, resembling brass or bronze. It features an arched doorway with a grid-like window pattern, and two vertical columns on each side with circular or square decorative elements. The roof is domed with a knob-like finial on top. The background is a plain, untextured off-white color, and there is a signature "h. schulze" in small, neat handwriting on the lower left side of the paper. The object is centered in the composition with no other items or decorations present.
title: Penny Bank
